trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and is healthy again. Error rate dropped from 0.18 to 0.002.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, so I didn't use it. Because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Partial failure:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, which left the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I retried once and the rollout completed cleanly.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api. The first request timed out, so I retried it with the same idempotency key. The incident is open and on-call has been paged. The summary covers the rollback, the partial failure, and the current state.

The follow-up is to investigate why v2.3.1 failed and why the rollout halted partway. Don't redeploy v2.3.1 until that's understood.

The rollout stopped partway: us-east is on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. Rolling back to v2.3.0 is the action you asked for, and that version was already healthy, so I'll retry once.
The rollback completed and checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
